THE DETAILS THAT MATTER

A few things
worth knowing.

How much do I contribute?+

KES 20 from each of your first five trips, up to KES 100 daily. The KES 3,000 monthly example is based on 150 contributing trips. Your total depends on your contributing activity.

When can I access my savings?+

Accumulated benefits remain preserved and inaccessible until retirement or a minimum of three years. Under the plan's maturity terms, continuing contributions after maturity renews the maturity period for another three years. Contact LAPFUND when you are ready to claim.

Is the whole contribution pension savings?+

No. Seventy-five per cent goes to pension savings, 8% to insurance, 8% to post-retirement medical and 9% to the Little Cab driver wallet. The insurance allocation pays for protection and is not a personal savings balance.

What do I need when claiming benefits?+

For exit claims, the product requirements include a completed LAPFUND Closure Form, copies of both sides of your ID, your KRA PIN certificate and bank-account evidence. Payments are made by EFT. Death and insurance claims require the relevant supporting documents.

What if I stop driving on Little?+

Little is required to notify LAPFUND when a member leaves the platform. Contact LAPFUND to discuss your membership and the applicable benefit-access conditions. Leaving the platform does not by itself promise an immediate payout.

YOUR PROTECTION

Cover details.

The plan's benefit schedule provides the following amounts.

Funeral & disability benefits

  • Principal member: KES 50,000 funeral cover / accidental permanent total disability.
  • Spouse: KES 50,000 funeral cover / accidental permanent total disability.
  • Children: KES 50,000 funeral cover / accidental permanent total disability.
  • Biological parents: KES 50,000 funeral cover.

Accident hospital cash

Principal member: KES 1,000 a day for a maximum of 10 days, up to KES 10,000. The schedule specifies a minimum three-day hospital stay.

Premium and payment conditions

The monthly premium in the KES 3,000 contribution model is KES 240. The benefit schedule also specifies “3 payments per year”. Contact LAPFUND for how this condition applies to your claim and for the applicable cover conditions.

Insurance protection is separate from post-retirement medical savings. This summary does not replace the applicable insurance and claims conditions.

Ask about your cover ↗

WHEN YOU NEED YOUR BENEFITS

Claims checklist.

Exit / retirement claim

  • Completed LAPFUND Closure Form.
  • Copy of your ID card, both sides.
  • Bank-card copy confirming the account details, bank and branch.
  • Copy of your KRA PIN certificate.

Payment is made through bank transfer (EFT). The plan provides for payment of eligible member savings and accrued returns within ten working days of receipt of complete claim documents.

On the death of a member

  • Completed LAPFUND Closure Form.
  • Certified death certificate or other supporting documents.
  • Claimants' national IDs, bank-card copies and PIN certificates.

Insurance claims

  • Permanent total disability: medical reports.
  • Accidental disability or death: police abstract.
  • Funeral benefit: death certificate, burial permit or supporting documents.
  • Hospitalisation: certified medical reports or discharge summary.

Contact LAPFUND for the correct forms and submission process. Do not send identity, bank or medical documents through this page.

PLAN INFORMATION

Plan terms.

This is a product summary for Little Cab drivers. Membership, contributions and benefits are subject to the applicable enrolment, scheme and insurance terms.

Eligibility and contributions

The plan is designed for Little Cab drivers admitted to LAPFUND membership. Contributions are KES 20 from each of the first five trips, up to KES 100 per day. KES 3,000 represents 150 contributing trips in a month.

Allocation

75% goes to pension savings, 8% to Personal Accident / Group Life Assurance, 8% to post-retirement medical and 9% to the Little Cab driver wallet. The insurance premium is not a savings balance.

Preservation and maturity

Accumulated benefits remain preserved and inaccessible until retirement or a minimum of three years. The maturity terms provide for three years of continuous contributions; continuing contributions after maturity renews the maturity period for a further three years. Contact LAPFUND for the applicable claim process.

Returns and payment

LAPFUND invests the pension contributions and credits declared investment income. A fixed investment return is not guaranteed. Applicable statutory deductions are made when benefits are paid. Eligible member savings and accrued returns are payable within ten working days after complete claim documents are received.

Insurance and medical provision

Funeral and accidental permanent total disability limits are KES 50,000 for the persons specified in the cover details. Accident hospital cash for the principal member is KES 1,000 a day, up to ten days and KES 10,000, with a minimum three-day hospital stay. The schedule states three payments per year. Eligibility and claims remain subject to applicable conditions. Post-retirement medical is a separate provision for healthcare after retirement.

Membership changes

Little notifies LAPFUND when a member ceases driving on the platform. Contact LAPFUND about membership changes and benefit access, and Little about trip deductions or platform issues.

Little platform terms

Driving on Little is separately subject to its licensing, vehicle, safety, conduct and other platform requirements. These do not replace the plan's benefit conditions.
